name: Securities Financing 12
definition: Details of the closing of the securities financing transaction.

RateChangeDate.name: Rate Change Date
RateChangeDate.definition: Date/Time at which rate change has taken place.

RateType.name: Rate Type
RateType.definition: Specifies whether the rate is fixed or variable.

Revaluation.name: Revaluation
Revaluation.definition: Specifies whether the collateral position should be subject to automatic revaluation by the account servicer.

InterestComputationMethod.name: Interest Computation Method
InterestComputationMethod.definition: Identifies the computation method of accrued interest of the related financial instrument.

VariableRateSupport.name: Variable Rate Support
VariableRateSupport.definition: Index or support rate used together with the spread to calculate the repurchase rate.

RepurchaseRate.name: Repurchase Rate
RepurchaseRate.definition: Repurchase rate used to calculate the repurchase amount.

StockLoanMargin.name: Stock Loan Margin
StockLoanMargin.definition: Percentage mark-up on a loan consideration used to reflect the lender's risk.

SecuritiesHaircut.name: Securities Haircut
SecuritiesHaircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the security expressed as a percentage.

PricingRate.name: Pricing Rate
PricingRate.definition: Interest rate to be paid on the transaction amount, as agreed between the counterparties.

SpreadRate.name: Spread Rate
SpreadRate.definition: Margin over or under an index that determines the repurchase rate, expressed as a rate or an amount.

CallableTradeIndicator.name: Callable Trade Indicator
CallableTradeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not the trade is callable.

TransactionCallDelay.name: Transaction Call Delay
TransactionCallDelay.definition: Minimum number of days' notice a counterparty needs for terminating the transaction.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest amount that has accrued in between two periods, for example, in between interest payment periods.

AccruedInterestPercentage.name: Accrued Interest Percentage
AccruedInterestPercentage.definition: Interest rate that has been accrued in between coupon payment periods.

ForfeitAmount.name: Forfeit Amount
ForfeitAmount.definition: Fixed amount of money that has to be paid (instead of interest) in the case of a recall or at the closing date.

PremiumAmount.name: Premium Amount
PremiumAmount.definition: Difference between the amount of money of the first leg and the amount of the second leg of the transaction.

ClosingAmountPerPiecesOfCollateral.name: Closing Amount Per Pieces Of Collateral
ClosingAmountPerPiecesOfCollateral.definition: Amount of money to be settled per piece of collateral to close the transaction.

TotalNumberOfCollateralInstructions.name: Total Number Of Collateral Instructions
TotalNumberOfCollateralInstructions.definition: Indicates the total Number of collateral instructions involved in the transaction.

FinancingAgreement.name: Financing Agreement
FinancingAgreement.definition: Provides details for the securities financing transaction.

LendingTransactionMethod.name: Lending Transaction Method
LendingTransactionMethod.definition: Method applied to a lending transaction.

LendingWithCollateral.name: Lending With Collateral
LendingWithCollateral.definition: Indicates if the contract is with or without an exchange of collateral.

BorrowingReason.name: Borrowing Reason
BorrowingReason.definition: Identifies the underlying reason for the borrowing, for instance, sale on my behalf or on behalf of a third party.

CollateralType.name: Collateral Type
CollateralType.definition: Indicates the type of collateral, for insatnce, security, bond, etc.

ContractTermsModificationChanged.name: Contract Terms Modification Changed
ContractTermsModificationChanged.definition: Indicates whether or not the contract terms changed.

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Interest rate to be paid as agreed between the counterparties.

BorrowingRate.name: Borrowing Rate
BorrowingRate.definition: Rate to be paid by the Borrower to the Lender for the securities borrowed.

StandardCollateralRatio.name: Standard Collateral Ratio
StandardCollateralRatio.definition: Method used to calculate the standard collateral amount.

DividendRatio.name: Dividend Ratio
DividendRatio.definition: Percentage of earnings paid to shareholders in dividends.

NumberOfDaysLendingBorrowing.name: Number Of Days Lending Borrowing
NumberOfDaysLendingBorrowing.definition: Number of days the securities are lent or borrowed where the contract has an agreed closing date.

AccruedInterestTax.name: Accrued Interest Tax
AccruedInterestTax.definition: Interest rate tax that has been accrued in between coupon payment periods.

EndNumberOfDaysAccrued.name: End Number Of Days Accrued
EndNumberOfDaysAccrued.definition: Number of days accrued at the instant of closing trade.

EndFactor.name: End Factor
EndFactor.definition: End ratio of principal outstanding to the original balance.

Reversible.name: Reversible
Reversible.definition: Indicates the possibility to terminate the securitiesc lending contract either by the borrower or lender before the expiration date.

MinimumDateForCallBack.name: Minimum Date For Call Back
MinimumDateForCallBack.definition: This is the minimum date at which the Borrower is allowed to give back the securities.

RollOver.name: Roll Over
RollOver.definition: Indicates that the contract can be rolled over.

PeriodicPayment.name: Periodic Payment
PeriodicPayment.definition: Indicates whether the securities lending fees can be paid periodically or at the end of the contract.

ExCoupon.name: Ex Coupon
ExCoupon.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex coupon.
